_baseline.description: WORK_PLAN C2/C3 baseline for DocClassifier across 33 OCR markdown fixtures

app-correction.input.md.note: Formal application to AC (Land) for R.S. khatian name correction with 2-column comparison table and attachment list.

app-holding.input.md.note: Formal application to AC (Land) to reactivate suspended holding with land schedule (তফসিল) table.

app-job.input.md.note: Hybrid cover-letter job application (বরাবর, পরিচালক ... নিয়োগের জন্য আবেদন) embedding a 12-item numbered bio-data and education table (GOVT_APP=18 vs CV_RESUME=17).

cash-memo-blank.input.md.note: Blank 2-copy retail cash memo (ক্যাশ মেমো, ক্রমিক|বিবরণ|পরিমাণ|দর|টাকা, ক্রেতার/বিক্রেতার স্বাক্ষর). Body heuristic misclassifies as GENERAL because DocClassifier has no cashMemoScore rules.

cash-memo-items.input.md.note: Pre-printed 3-copy 24-item order/cash memo (মেসার্স মাসফিয়া ট্রেডার্স, ক্যাশ মেমো). Body heuristic misclassifies as OFFICE_PAD (score 6 via মেসার্স/প্রোঃ) because CASH_MEMO has no heuristic rules.

cert-landscape.input.md.note: School প্রত্যয়ন পত্র in landscape orientation with grading scale table.

cert-stub.input.md.note: Two-part primary school प्रशংসা পত্র / ছাড়পত্র with left counterfoil stub separated by '***' in landscape layout.

combined.input.md.note: SSC Physics combined exam with creative question ([উদ্দীপক ১], ১. ক–ঘ), explicit ---SECTION_BREAK:MCQ---, and MCQ section.

cq-booklet-10.input.md.note: Class 8 Science 10-question CQ booklet with stimulus tables and অথবা alternatives.

cq-booklet-16.input.md.note: Class 8 Science 16-question CQ booklet with stimulus tables and অথবা alternatives.

cq-booklet-6.input.md.note: Class 8 Science 6-question CQ booklet with অথবা alternatives.

cq-inline-numbering.input.md.note: Class 10 Chemistry CQ exam using inline question+sub-question numbering (১. ক. ... ১).

cq-long.input.md.note: Class 8 Science 3-question CQ exam with inline numbering (১. ক.) and no trailing mark digits.

cq-marks-edge.input.md.note: Class 9 Physics 3-question CQ exam with inline numbering (১। ক.) and varied mark formats (plain, [১], (৩), omitted).

cq-short.input.md.note: Class 10 Bangla 1st Paper 2-question CQ exam with inline numbering (১. ক.).

cv-basic.input.md.note: Standard Bangla জীবন বৃত্তান্ত with 8 numbered fields and education table.

cv-biodata.input.md.note: Short Bangla বায়োডাটা with personal details and অঙ্গীকার declaration.

cv-english.input.md.note: English Curriculum Vitae with personal profile, education table, and declaration.

cv-long.input.md.note: Detailed 20-field Bangla জীবন বৃত্তান্ত with education table, reference, and declaration.

math-equations.input.md.note: Class 11 Higher Math 5-question tutorial exam with LaTeX equations ($...$, \frac, \int, \begin{pmatrix}).

mcq-header-fallback.input.md.note: 14-question pure MCQ paper without institution/exam header block.

mcq-long-options.input.md.note: Class 9 Physics 14-question MCQ paper with long sentence-length options.

mcq-mixed-options.input.md.note: Class 9 ICT 6-question pure MCQ paper (one option per line). Body heuristic misclassifies as EXAM_GENERAL because isPureMcqPaper requires mcqBlockCount >= 10.

mcq-shrink-21.input.md.note: Class 6 Science 21-question pure MCQ paper designed to fit on a single page.

pad-notice.input.md.note: Hybrid document: committee letterhead/pad (স্মারক + তারিখ) carrying a show-cause notice (বরাবর + বিষয়: কারণ দর্শানোর নোটিশ + অনুলিপি). Body heuristic returns OFFICIAL_NOTICE because !/বরাবর/.test(t) blocks padScore.

pad-school-app.input.md.note: Hybrid document: government primary school letterhead/pad (সূত্র + তারিখ) carrying an official application to the UNO (বরাবর + বিষয় + সবিনয়ে অনুরোধ). Body heuristic returns GOVT_APP because !/বরাবর/.test(t) blocks padScore.

primary-class4-bangla.input.md.note: Class 4 Bangla 3rd semester 15-question general exam (word meaning, Q&A, fill-in-blanks, grammar, letter, essay).

prottoyon-school.input.md.note: High school headmaster's প্রত্যয়নপত্র with স্মারক নং and character attestation.

prottoyon-up.input.md.note: Union Parishad Chairman's নাম সংশোধনী প্রত্যয়নপত্র with স্মারক নং.

receipt.input.md.note: School fee money receipt (টাকা প্রাপ্তির রসিদ, ৮ম শ্রেণির ভর্তি ফি বাবদ). Mapped to CASH_MEMO in absence of a dedicated RECEIPT type. Body heuristic misclassifies as EXAM_GENERAL because '৮ম শ্রেণির' matches /শ্রেণি/.

voucher.input.md.note: School expense voucher (খরচের ভাউচার, ভাউচার নং: ৪৫). Mapped to CASH_MEMO in absence of a dedicated VOUCHER type. Body heuristic misclassifies as GENERAL due to missing voucher/cash-memo rules.
